verdict.rationale: Choosing where data is stored is a fair question for a hosted communication platform like Discord, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any user- or server-level control over data storage region or residency. The pack covers developer APIs, the Social SDK, Nitro perks and community discussion unrelated to residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
